topic: Data Science Capstone Architecture and Implementation
learningObjectives: Define a complete data science problem and its success criteria.
Design an end-to-end architecture for a data science solution.
Connect data ingestion, processing, modeling, and prediction components.

activities.title: Problem Definition
activities.instruction: Match project requirements with measurable success criteria.

content.concept: A strong data science project starts with a clearly defined problem, target outcome, constraints, and measurable success criteria.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

choices: Business Problem → Clearly describe what needs to be solved
Target Variable → Define what the model should predict
Success Metric → Define how the solution will be evaluated
Constraints → Identify limitations such as time, cost, data, or latency
Acceptance Criteria → Define conditions that indicate the solution meets requirements
config.answer: Success Metric → Define how the solution will be evaluated

activities.title: Capstone Architecture
activities.instruction: Explore how the major components of a data science solution connect.

content.concept: A data science architecture connects data sources, ingestion, processing, feature engineering, models, APIs, and user-facing outputs.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

descriptions: Provide raw information such as files, databases, APIs, or sensors.
Collects data into the processing system.
Cleans, validates, and transforms the data.
Creates or selects features for the model.
Presents predictions, insights, or results to users.

activities.title: Pipeline Builder
activities.instruction: Build the end-to-end workflow from raw data to prediction.

content.concept: An end-to-end pipeline transforms raw data into validated model predictions or analytical insights.

activities.title: Component Sequence
activities.instruction: Order the main stages of capstone implementation.

content.concept: A structured implementation sequence helps integrate components while keeping development and evaluation measurable.
